-- R-410: 零售帳戶多條件異常清單(條件 1 或條件 2 任一成立)
SELECT s.account_id, s.atm_cnt, s.atm_amt, s.in_amt, s.in_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP11','OP12')) AS atm_cnt,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP11','OP12')), 0) AS atm_amt,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
            WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03') AND t.amount > 1000), 0) AS in_amt,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03') AND t.amount > 1000) AS in_cnt
    FROM txn_log t
    WHERE COALESCE(t.rev_flag, 'N') <> 'Y'
      AND COALESCE(t.channel_name, '') <> 'PROMO'
      AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
    GROUP BY t.account_id
) s
WHERE (s.atm_cnt >= 2 AND s.atm_cnt <= 3
       AND s.atm_amt >= 50000 AND s.atm_amt <= 100000
       AND s.in_amt >= 80000 AND s.in_amt <= 100000)
   OR (s.atm_cnt >= 4 AND s.atm_cnt <= 10
       AND s.atm_amt >= 90000 AND s.atm_amt <= 150000
       AND s.in_cnt >= 2 AND s.in_cnt <= 3);

_golden.intent: 正向對照(R-410):多條件 OR-of-ANDs 全部照規格,含兩端邊界正確。這份規格條件數多,同時也在測『測資生成 agent 能不能拆得完整』——若 coverage_gaps 很多,代表複雜規格的執行驗證能力有上限。
_golden.gap_note: 實測:R-410 是 OR-of-ANDs 結構(組內 AND、組間 OR),測資生成 agent 對條件 2 組的 C2-2 / C2-3 兩向案例全缺,coverage_gaps 非空 → spec_exec.passed 為 false。根因:TESTGEN_SYSTEM 的契約假設「條件彼此獨立、各自可翻轉真假」,但巢狀結構下單一子條件無法獨立測試(要讓 C2-2 為真且整體命中,必須同時滿足同組的 C2-1 與 C2-3)。修補方向:讓測資生成契約認識「條件組」,以組為單位構造基底資料後逐項翻轉。對照:扁平規格 R-140(16 案例)、R-520(14 案例)皆完整覆蓋,可見限制在結構巢狀而非規格難度。
